result.title: ScoutRoute: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Routing Using Internal Language Model Signals
result.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Published in Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, 2026
result.summary: Efficient expert routing is a fundamental challenge in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) systems, particularly for heterogeneous collections of independently trained Large Language Mod els (LLMs). Existing routing approaches typically rely on jointly trained gating networks, prompt-based predictors, or computationally expensive multi-model inference, limiting their flexibility and efficiency. This paper presents ScoutRoute, a lightweight post-hoc routing framework that predicts expert competence using internal language model signals extracted from a single forward pass through an inexpensive scout model. Hidden-state representations are used to estimate cross-model competence through lightweight logistic probes, while logit-derived confidence measures are incorporated within a domain-aware routing strategy for efficient expert selec tion without modifying the underlying language models. ScoutRoute isevaluatedon fiveopen-weightlanguagemodels across fourbenchmark datasets covering mathematical reasoning, code generation, commonsense reasoning, and multidis ciplinary knowledge. Experimental results show that ScoutRoute consistently outperforms individual routing signals while requiring only a single scout-model inference. The proposed competence probes also achieve superior calibration compared with conventional confidence measures, demonstrating that internal language model representations provide transferable information for accurate and efficient expert routing across heterogeneous language models

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ScoutRoute：仅文本的 post-hoc MoE 路由框架，用廉价 scout 模型单次前向的隐藏态训练轻量 logistic 探针预测各专家胜任度，并结合 logit 置信度做领域感知路由，在五个开源 LLM 与四类基准上验证其优于单一路由信号且校准更好。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以内部隐藏态探针预测胜任度并做置信度校准」的做法，可能为 LVR 中依据内部状态判断是否继续 latent 推理或停止（THINK/STOP）提供线索，但论文完全面向纯文本跨模型路由，与视觉证据和 LVR 状态表示的关联待核查。
